summary: This clinical trial studies how a drug called HDM1002 affects other medications in healthy and overweight adults. The study looks at pharmacokinetics, which is how the body processes medicines over time. The status of this trial is Unknown status. It is sponsored by Hangzhou Zhongmei Huadong Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and aims to include 30 participants.
